annotations.title: Run the next stage of a story film

description: Runs the next stage of a story film run and stops for approval. Without approve it only reads the run and quotes the next stage (free). approve:true runs it: screenplay (billed at its writing tokens), boards (cast, location and one board per act, each paint billed as an image), clips (every act filmed from the approved boards and joined in order, reserved at the quote), final cut (free). Pass `creative` to replace the screenplay with an edited one (boards are repainted for it), or lengthSeconds to re-outline. A stage still rendering says so; call again to pick it up.

approve.description: run the next stage (the user saw its quote and said yes)

creative.description: an edited screenplay (the creative this tool returned, changed) to use instead

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

lengthSeconds.description: re-outline at this length (throws away the screenplay and boards)
